subject: Catalyst Labs — DPA & SCCs: mapping, redlines, and MSA alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@catalystlabs.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@catalystlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA / SCCs — Catalyst initial redlines and questions

Marcus — thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Attaching our annotated DPA and a suggested SCCs mapping for your legal team to review. High-level asks from Catalyst legal: 

- Confirm processor/controller role mapping for the Order Form (we flagged a few ambiguous entries in section 2).
- Can Redwood accept our SCCs variant in lieu of the standard EU SCCs Annex? (we've highlighted differences).
- We propose an explicit transfer-impact addendum (short paragraph) in the DPA to cover on-prem/private deployments.

Please advise who on your side should own the technical evidence and who will be the signature contact for the MSA + Order Form. We're targeting a product go-live window in Q4 and need the legal path cleared this month.

Attachments: Catalyst_DPA_annotated.pdf (annotated PDF, comments), Catalyst_SCCs_matrix.xlsx (matrix with jurisdiction mapping)

—Sofia
Sofia Torres
Head of Legal Operations, Catalyst Labs
sofia.torres@catalystlabs.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@catalystlabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs — Catalyst initial redlines and questions

Hi Sofia — thanks for the materials and the clear asks. Looping in Ben (sales lead on the deal) and Laura from Legal so they can triage redlines. Quick responses inline: 

- Role mapping: we usually accept controller/processor splits per Order Form but we need to reconcile a few items in the matrix you sent (see attached suggested tie-outs).
- SCCs variant: we can evaluate, but Redwood prefers either the standard EU SCCs (2021) or mutually-agreed Annex; Laura, please confirm the risk posture if we accept Catalyst's variant.
- Transfer-impact addendum for private/on-prem: reasonable — we need to decide whether it becomes an Exhibit to the DPA or a short Order Form clause.

Ben — can you confirm the target contract signers and whether procurement will need a PO or SOW?

Next step: propose a 30-min legal-to-legal sync next week. Laura, Neha — are you available Mon/Tue?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Target timeline: we need executed terms by end of September to meet the internal launch. I'll coordinate procurement-side data (billing contact, billing address) once redlines are agreed.

I'll sit in on the legal sync — Monday 10am PT works for me.

—Ben

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@catalystlabs.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:56:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs — Catalyst initial redlines and questions

Sofia / Marcus — thanks for sending. I reviewed the annotated DPA and the SCCs matrix. Summary of legal positions and outstanding items: 

1) SCCs variant: We can accept Catalyst's alternative SCCs only if (a) deviations are limited to non-substantive language or clarifying definitions, and (b) Catalyst signs a short addendum confirming no expansion of controller obligations. If deviations include liability caps or data-subject rights language, we will request redlines back to the standard Annex.

2) Role mapping: The matrix flags three ambiguous processing activities (analytics, fine-tuning/derived model weights, and telemetry). We need Catalyst to confirm whether they will instruct Redwood to process telemetry-derived telemetry for model improvement (that implies controller instructions and longer retention).

3) Transfer-impact addendum: Acceptable as an Exhibit. Proposed language: one paragraph that references our standard export control measures, KMS regions, and customer-specific on-prem routing. Engineering will confirm feasibility of the routing controls.

Open evidence asks (Neha to own): 
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) — provided by Redwood Ops (we'll attach).
- KMS whitepaper + list of regions used for Catalyst (ops question).
- Subprocessor roster snapshot and subprocessor SOCs where applicable.

Neha — can you prepare an evidence package and estimated delivery date for Catalyst?

If Catalyst is available, let's do the 30-min call Tue 11am PT; please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@catalystlabs.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs — Catalyst initial redlines and questions

Sofia — quick evidence update following our call last week: 

- SOC 2 Type II: staging copy attached (will supply certified report once signed NDA completes).
- KMS regions & key management: attached KMS_overview.pdf (redacted); we can commit to keys in US / eu-west-1 as part of the transfer-impact Exhibit.
- Subprocessors: current roster (partial) attached; we will produce the full roster within 5 business days and flag any subprocessor-specific SOCs.

Regarding the three ambiguous processing activities: Catalyst confirmed in the call that telemetry for product improvement will be provided as a separate, clearly-marked feed and Catalyst will consent to Redwood processing it for model improvement subject to retention limits (60 days default). We'll capture that in the DPA Exhibit. 

Next steps we agreed on call: 
1) Redwood Legal (Laura) to produce a short redline of the MSA DPA with proposed Exhibit language and SCCs acceptance criteria by EOD next Wed (2026-08-25).
2) Catalyst to mark any SCC clauses they view as non-negotiable and return a clean list (Amit).
3) Ben/Marcus to prepare the final Order Form draft for procurement.

Attachments: SOC2_staging.pdf, KMS_overview.pdf, Subprocessor_roster_partial.xlsx

—Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
